review_basis: Reopened all 70 exact source findings, including all same-key occurrences on each source line; decoded complete JSON values instead of accepting field names as evidence.
Independently verified all 93 original file SHA256/byte counts against the manifest and raw scan, plus all 93 expanded-unit SHA256/byte counts.
Verified the six scanner non-JSON reports are UTF-8 truncations of the bounded scan slice; complete values are ordinary robot evidence.

Manifest paths contain no account response or credential file. Only manifest payload files, preserved scanner/package source and scan metadata were read; private /tmp account responses and credential values were not accessed.
No secret-pattern or actual-local-sensitive-value finding was waived.
limitations: Pattern scanning cannot prove absence of every arbitrary/unknown secret format.
Actual secret comparison reads only sensitive nonempty entries from the explicitly selected .env.local, in memory; no secret values or their hashes are emitted.
Credential JSON keys are scanned lexically, including large JSON/JSONL; quoted source examples may require explicit classification.
Gzip payloads and all regular members of frozen-runtime-source.tar.gz are recursively scanned without extraction; unsupported archive entries fail closed.
No OCR of images or decoding of arbitrary embedded binary image data is performed.
Report covers exactly the original manifest files, not future delivery files or the archive container created afterward.
